comment: * Class with information of touch delegated views and regions.

methods.name: public int getRegionCount()
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of touch delegate target region. *

* Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 29: Always returns {@code 0}
    • *
* * @return Number of touch delegate target region.

methods.name: public Region getRegionAt(@IntRange(from = 0) int index)
methods.comment:
* Return the {@link Region} at the given index. *

* Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 29: Always returns {@code null}
    • *
* * @param index The desired index, must be between 0 and {@link #getRegionCount()}-1. * @return Returns the {@link Region} stored at the given index.

methods.name: public AccessibilityNodeInfoCompat getTargetForRegion(@NonNull Region region)
methods.comment:
* Return the target {@link AccessibilityNodeInfoCompat} for the given {@link Region}. *

* Note: This api can only be called from * {@link android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService}. *

*

* Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 29: Always returns {@code null}
    • *
* * @param region The region retrieved from {@link #getRegionAt(int)}. * @return The target node associates with the given region.
